title: Deferred Fixed Annuities Service Standard: Default Renewal of SecureRate Guarantee Periods
content:
**Product:** Deferred Fixed Annuities — the Ashgrove SecureRate 3, 5, 6, 7 and 10 (the Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity has no guarantee period renewal of this kind).

## Standard

A SecureRate contract whose guarantee period has ended without a renewal election renews by default into a new guarantee period of the same length, starting the day after the guarantee period end date, and the renewal is recorded with the default renewal rate.

A renewal election of a different guarantee period must be received no later than the guarantee period end date plus the tier's renewal window length in days; a renewal by default needs no election.

## What recording a default renewal changes

| On the contract record | After the renewal is recorded |
|---|---|
| Guaranteed rate | The default renewal rate |
| Start of the new guarantee period and of the new surrender charge schedule | The day after the old guarantee period end date |
| Guarantee period end date | Moved forward by the tier's period length (3, 5, 6, 7 or 10 years, as in the tier name) |
| Contract value and activity history | Not touched |

*Illustration (hypothetical):* an Ashgrove SecureRate 5 whose guarantee period ends on 31 March 2026, with no election, renews from 1 April 2026; its new guarantee period ends on 31 March 2031 and its new surrender charge schedule starts on 1 April 2026.

## Recording tool: `renew_guarantee_period_14f04954`

**Capability.** Records the renewal by default of a SecureRate contract's guarantee period into a new period of the same length: sets the guaranteed rate to the rate given, starts the new guarantee period and a new surrender charge schedule on the day after the current guarantee period end date, and moves the guarantee period end date forward by the tier's period length. The contract value and the activity history are not touched.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, passing the tool name `renew_guarantee_period_14f04954` and its arguments.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `fixed_contract_id` | The reference number of the SecureRate contract whose guarantee period renews, as read from the contract lookup | Identifier, as recorded |
| `renewal_rate` | The annual effective rate guaranteed for the new period | A decimal fraction with exactly 4 decimal places (0.0525 means 5.25 percent), rounded half up to the fourth decimal place before it is passed |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation: "Contract <contract reference> renewed: rate <rate> from <start date> to <end date>." The rate has 4 decimal places and both dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Receiving this line means the new guarantee period is recorded on the contract. No other return is defined.
